n19dbfae84c.summary: Kazakhstan's National Bank has introduced the ÚKI investment coin within its gold coin project.
n19dbfae84c.why: Sovereign gold coins are bullion-backed products that give investors and savers exposure to physical gold.

n3e137c6b50.headline: Gold Prices Surge Past $3,000 Mark Amid Economic Uncertainty
n3e137c6b50.summary: Gold prices have surged past the $3,000 mark amid economic uncertainty. The rally reflects investor demand for a traditional safe-haven asset.
n3e137c6b50.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that investors buy during economic and financial stress, and its price is a common benchmark for inflation and currency concerns. It is quoted mainly on COMEX in New York.

n97adbc6048.headline: TSX futures rise; index set for weekly loss on heightened trade war
n97adbc6048.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index jumped on Friday, but the benchmark was on track for a sharp weekly fall as the escalating trade war with the United States raised concerns. The report was published by MarketScreener.
n97adbc6048.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and it is heavily weighted toward energy, materials and financials, which are sensitive to US trade policy. Its weekly moves reflect shifts in trade expectations.
n97adbc6048.why_moved: Concern over an escalating trade war with the United States drove the index toward a sharp weekly decline, despite a futures rally on Friday.

n07395c2d34.headline: Nigeria’s trade exports hit $50.4 billion as exchange rate depreciation and fuel subsidy removal boost trade balance
n07395c2d34.summary: Nigeria's total trade exports surged to $50.4 billion in 2024, driven by exchange rate depreciation and the elimination of fuel subsidies, which boosted the trade balance.
n07395c2d34.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy and a major oil exporter, so its trade flows and currency policy affect oil-linked assets and frontier-market investors.

n7baf4b6867.headline: Why CEOs are calm about tariffs in public — but 'very discouraged' in private
n7baf4b6867.summary: Business leaders are engaging in delicate diplomacy with the White House as companies brace for market volatility and tariff impacts, according to the report.
n7baf4b6867.why: Tariffs raise input costs and can disrupt supply chains, so corporate sentiment on trade policy is closely watched by equity investors.

n37ab1e6270.headline: Asda cuts fuel prices by 4p per litre amid drop in wholesale costs
n37ab1e6270.summary: Asda is cutting fuel prices by 4p per litre amid a drop in wholesale costs. The move follows an RAC call for prices to fall from a six-month high.
n37ab1e6270.why: Asda is a major UK supermarket chain that also runs fuel forecourts, so pump prices affect consumer spending and retail fuel margins.

ncdb0a90364.headline: Fitch affirms Poland at 'A-' with outlook stable
ncdb0a90364.summary: Fitch Ratings has affirmed Poland's long-term foreign-currency issuer default rating at 'A-' with a stable outlook. The agency forecasts average inflation for the country.
ncdb0a90364.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence the borrowing costs of governments and the pricing of their bonds and currency for international investors.

nb7698b89b0.headline: Germany is back, says Friedrich Merz after historic deal on defence and spending
nb7698b89b0.summary: Germany's conservative leader Friedrich Merz has clinched a major financial agreement on defence and spending ahead of a crucial parliamentary vote.
nb7698b89b0.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and changes to its defence and fiscal spending affect eurozone growth and European defence stocks.

ne272f38795.headline: Will the UK enter a recession after Britain’s GDP shrinks unexpectedly?
ne272f38795.summary: UK GDP unexpectedly fell in the first month of 2025, prompting questions over whether Britain will enter a recession. The contraction came against a backdrop of weak growth.
ne272f38795.why: GDP measures the total output of an economy, and a contraction shapes expectations for Bank of England policy, gilt yields and sterling. Investors watch these readings closely for signs of recession.
ne272f38795.why_moved: GDP unexpectedly fell in January 2025, which raised concerns about a recession. Unexpected contractions tend to weigh on sentiment and sterling-linked assets.

n6f0f6e4f2b.headline: Singapore stocks end flat on March 14 amid mixed regional finishes
n6f0f6e4f2b.summary: Singapore stocks ended flat on March 14 as regional markets finished mixed. Advancers beat decliners 338 to 207 across the broader market.
n6f0f6e4f2b.why: The Straits Times Index is the benchmark for Singapore's equity market and a gauge of the city-state's listed companies. Its daily moves reflect banking, property and trade-linked stocks.

n8fb6cc4f5a.headline: Concerns transfer functions from Milan to Paris
n8fb6cc4f5a.summary: Forza Italia is expressing concern about the transfer of some functions from Borsa Italiana to Paris and Amsterdam, including the handling of new share listings.
n8fb6cc4f5a.why: Borsa Italiana operates Italy's main stock exchange, and its functions shape where listings and trading infrastructure sit within Europe.

n60ec7f5860.headline: Fitch thinks S.Africa will struggle to stabilise debt as projected in budget
n60ec7f5860.summary: Fitch Ratings said South Africa's government would struggle to stabilise debt as projected in the revised 2025 budget. The comment came on Friday.
n60ec7f5860.why: Rating agency assessments of sovereign debt sustainability influence government bond yields and the cost of borrowing.

n51193a34eb.headline: JSE and Rapid Addition join forces  - Asset Servicing Times
n51193a34eb.summary: The JSE and Rapid Addition have joined forces on the JSE-FIX solution, which uses Rapid Addition's order routing technology. It is said to offer vendor-neutral connectivity for asset managers.
n51193a34eb.why: The JSE is South Africa's main securities exchange, and connectivity services affect how institutional investors route trades.

nac4695cfc4.headline: Bitcoin drops below $82K as crypto markets slide despite cooling US inflation
nac4695cfc4.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $82,000 as crypto markets slid, even though US inflation has cooled.
nac4695cfc4.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price is a common gauge of risk appetite across digital asset markets.
nac4695cfc4.why_moved: Bitcoin slipped below $82,000 as crypto markets declined, despite cooling US inflation data.

nd8df17eb15.headline: Trump’s trade war only benefits China, EU foreign policy chief says - National | Globalnews.ca
nd8df17eb15.summary: The EU's foreign policy chief said tariffs between Western countries only serve China's interests. She called for higher defence spending to keep Russia in check.
nd8df17eb15.why: Tariff disputes between the US and EU affect trade flows, export margins and supply chains for transatlantic companies.

n552c8bc6da.headline: Naira records highest depreciation against dollar in 48 hours
n552c8bc6da.summary: The naira continued its depreciation against the dollar across foreign exchange markets for the fourth consecutive session. The article reports it recorded the largest fall in 48 hours.
n552c8bc6da.why: The naira is Nigeria's currency, and its movements affect import costs, inflation and the returns foreign investors earn on Nigerian assets.

n0418d94f4e.headline: UK economy sputters, underlining growth challenge
n0418d94f4e.summary: Britain's economy shrank in January, official figures show, a setback for finance minister Rachel Reeves before her next steps.
n0418d94f4e.why: Monthly GDP data shape expectations for Bank of England interest-rate decisions and the outlook for UK assets.
n0418d94f4e.why_moved: The report says the economy shrank in January, which weakens the growth outlook the government and markets were watching.

ncdd92409a3.headline: Roundup: S&P 500 falls into correction territory amid continuous sell-off
ncdd92409a3.summary: The S&P 500 entered correction territory on Thursday as US stocks extended recent losses. Concerns centred on a tariff-driven slowdown in economic growth and corporate earnings.
ncdd92409a3.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of US equity market performance.

n117b8bff85.summary: Turkish Trade Minister Ömer Bolat said during a visit to Kyiv that Türkiye is ready to aid Ukraine's reconstruction and expand economic ties.
n117b8bff85.why: Reconstruction spending and trade partnerships in Ukraine create opportunities for contractors and exporters in neighbouring economies.

n6b0e57bb4a.headline: Asda slashes fuel prices by 4p per litre in major boost for drivers

n6b0e57bb4a.why: Asda is a major UK supermarket chain, and its fuel retailing reflects wholesale fuel costs and competition among UK forecourt operators.

n25458217bd.headline: Eby announces ending of provincial carbon tax, after Carney kills federal version
n25458217bd.summary: British Columbia will follow through on its promise to repeal its consumer carbon tax. New Prime Minister Mark Carney has moved to kill the federal version.
n25458217bd.why: Carbon pricing affects fuel and energy costs for consumers and businesses, and policy shifts influence Canada's climate-related regulatory outlook.

n16d5879365.summary: UK figures showed a surprise contraction in the economy in January, a setback for Chancellor Rachel Reeves ahead of her spring statement.

nb553db4a01.summary: ECB policymaker Robert Holzmann backs keeping interest rates unchanged next month. He cites higher trade tariffs and more government spending as risks to inflation.

n4540c7dc7e.headline: Drone maker ideaForge plans higher R&D spend this fiscal year

n7adca2023e.summary: The benchmark KSE-100 index gained 442 points as buying continued at the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
